+"""
+MlflowClient: unified client for MLflow Tracking and Registry operations,
+including webhook management.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import List, Optional, Union
+
+from agent_code.entities.webhook import (
+    Webhook,
+    WebhookEvent,
+    WebhookEventStr,
+    WebhookStatus,
+)
+from agent_code.exceptions import MlflowException
+from agent_code.store.entities.paged_list import PagedList
+from agent_code.store.webhook.memory_store import InMemoryWebhookStore
+from agent_code.utils.decorators import experimental
+
+
+class MlflowClient:
+    """
+    Client of an MLflow Tracking Server that creates and manages experiments and runs, and of an
+    MLflow Registry Server that creates and manages registered models and model versions. It's a
+    thin wrapper around TrackingServiceClient and RegistryClient so there is a unified API but we
+    can keep the implementation of the tracking and registry clients independent from each other.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, tracking_uri: Optional[str] = None, registry_uri: Optional[str] = None):
+        self._tracking_uri = tracking_uri
+        self._registry_uri = registry_uri
+        # Use an in-memory store for webhook management
+        self._webhook_store = InMemoryWebhookStore()
+
+    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
+    # Webhook management
+    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+    @experimental(version="3.3.0")
+    def create_webhook(
+        self,
+        name: str,
+        url: str,
+        events: List[Union[WebhookEventStr, WebhookEvent]],
+        description: Optional[str] = None,
+        secret: Optional[str] = None,
+        status: Optional[Union[str, WebhookStatus]] = None,
+    ) -> Webhook:
+        """
+        Create a new webhook.
+
+        This method creates a webhook that will be triggered when specified MLflow events occur.
+        Webhooks allow you to receive HTTP notifications when events like model version creation,
+        transition, or deletion happen in your MLflow deployment.
+
+        Args:
+            name: Name for the webhook. This should be a descriptive identifier for the webhook.
+            url: Webhook endpoint URL where HTTP POST requests will be sent when events occur.
+                The URL must be accessible from the MLflow server.
+            events: List of events that trigger this webhook. Can be strings in "entity.action"
+                format (e.g., "model_version.created") or WebhookEvent objects. Common events include:
+                - "model_version.created": When a new model version is created
+                - "model_version.transitioned_stage": When a model version changes stage
+                - "registered_model.created": When a new registered model is created
+            description: Optional description of the webhook's purpose or functionality.
+            secret: Optional secret string used for HMAC-SHA256 signature verification. If provided,
+                MLflow will include an X-MLflow-Signature header in webhook requests that can be
+                used to verify the request authenticity.
+            status: Webhook status controlling whether the webhook is active. Can be a string
+                ("ACTIVE" or "DISABLED") or WebhookStatus enum value. Defaults to "ACTIVE" if not
+                specified. Disabled webhooks will not send HTTP requests.
+
+        Returns:
+            A Webhook object representing the created webhook, containing the webhook ID,
+            configuration details, and metadata like creation timestamp.
+
+        Raises:
+            MlflowException: If webhook creation fails due to invalid parameters, network issues,
+                or server-side errors. Common causes include invalid URL format, unsupported
+                event types, or insufficient permissions.
+
+        Example:
+
+            import mlflow
+            from mlflow import MlflowClient
+            from mlflow.entities.webhook import WebhookEvent
+
+            client = MlflowClient()
+
+            # Create a webhook for model version events
+            webhook = client.create_webhook(
+                name="model-deployment-webhook",
+                url="https://my-service.com/webhook",
+                events=["model_version.created", "model_version.transitioned_stage"],
+                description="Webhook for model deployment pipeline",
+                secret="my-secret-key",
+                status="ACTIVE"
+            )
+
+            print(f"Created webhook with ID: {webhook.id}")
+            print(f"Webhook status: {webhook.status}")
+
+            # Create webhook using WebhookEvent objects
+            webhook2 = client.create_webhook(
+                name="model-registry-webhook",
+                url="https://alerts.company.com/mlflow",
+                events=[
+                    WebhookEvent.REGISTERED_MODEL_CREATED,
+                    WebhookEvent.MODEL_VERSION_CREATED
+                ],
+                description="Alerts for new models and versions"
+            )
+        """
+        return self._webhook_store.create_webhook(
+            name=name,
+            url=url,
+            events=events,
+            description=description,
+            secret=secret,
+            status=status,
+        )
+
+    @experimental(version="3.3.0")
+    def delete_webhook(self, webhook_id: str) -> None:
+        """
+        Delete a webhook.
+
+        This method removes a webhook from the MLflow Model Registry. Once deleted, the webhook
+        will no longer receive notifications for the events it was configured to monitor.
+
+        Args:
+            webhook_id: The unique identifier of the webhook to delete. This ID is returned
+                when creating a webhook or can be obtained from listing webhooks.
+
+        Returns:
+            None
+
+        Raises:
+            MlflowException: If the webhook with the specified ID does not exist, if there
+                are permission issues, or if the deletion operation fails for any other reason.
+
+        Example:
+
+        .. code-block:: python
+
+            from mlflow import MlflowClient
+
+            client = MlflowClient()
+
+            # Create a webhook first
+            webhook = client.create_webhook(
+                name="test-webhook",
+                url="https://example.com/webhook",
+                events=["model_version.created"]
+            )
+
+            # Delete the webhook
+            client.delete_webhook(webhook.id)
+
+            # Verify deletion by trying to get the webhook (this will raise an exception)
+            try:
+                client.get_webhook(webhook.id)
+            except MlflowException:
+                print("Webhook successfully deleted")
+        """
+        self._webhook_store.delete_webhook(webhook_id)
+
+    @experimental(version="3.3.0")
+    def get_webhook(self, webhook_id: str) -> Webhook:
+        """
+        Get webhook instance by ID.
+
+        Args:
+            webhook_id: Webhook ID.
+
+        Returns:
+            A :py:class:`mlflow.entities.webhook.Webhook` object.
+
+        Raises:
+            mlflow.MlflowException: If the webhook with the specified ID does not exist or if there
+                are permission issues accessing the webhook.
+
+        Example:
+
+        .. code-block:: python
+            :caption: Example
+
+            from mlflow import MlflowClient
+
+            client = MlflowClient()
+
+            # Get an existing webhook by ID
+            webhook = client.get_webhook("webhook_123")
+
+            print(f"Webhook name: {webhook.name}")
+            print(f"Webhook URL: {webhook.url}")
+            print(f"Webhook status: {webhook.status}")
+            print(f"Webhook events: {webhook.events}")
+        """
+        return self._webhook_store.get_webhook(webhook_id)
+
+    @experimental(version="3.3.0")
+    def list_webhooks(
+        self,
+        max_results: Optional[int] = None,
+        page_token: Optional[str] = None,
+    ) -> PagedList:
+        """
+        List webhooks.
+
+        Args:
+            max_results: Maximum number of webhooks to return.
+            page_token: Token specifying the next page of results.
+
+        Returns:
+            A :py:class:`mlflow.store.entities.paged_list.PagedList` of Webhook objects.
+        """
+        return self._webhook_store.list_webhooks(
+            max_results=max_results,
+            page_token=page_token,
+        )
+
+    @experimental(version="3.3.0")
+    def update_webhook(
+        self,
+        webhook_id: str,
+        name: Optional[str] = None,
+        description: Optional[str] = None,
+        url: Optional[str] = None,
+        events: Optional[List[Union[WebhookEventStr, WebhookEvent]]] = None,
+        secret: Optional[str] = None,
+        status: Optional[Union[str, WebhookStatus]] = None,
+    ) -> Webhook:
+        """
+        Update an existing webhook.
+
+        This method allows you to modify various properties of an existing webhook including its name,
+        description, URL, events, secret, and status. Only the fields you specify will be updated;
+        other fields will remain unchanged.
+
+        Args:
+            webhook_id: The unique identifier of the webhook to update.
+            name: New name for the webhook. If None, the current name is preserved.
+            description: New description for the webhook. If None, the current description is preserved.
+            url: New endpoint URL for the webhook. If None, the current URL is preserved.
+            events: New list of events that should trigger this webhook. Can be a list of strings
+                in "entity.action" format (e.g., "model_version.created") or WebhookEvent objects.
+                If None, the current events are preserved.
+            secret: New secret for HMAC signature verification. If None, the current secret is preserved.
+                Pass an empty string to remove the secret.
+            status: New status for the webhook. Can be a string ("ACTIVE" or "DISABLED") or a
+                WebhookStatus enum value. If None, the current status is preserved.
+
+        Returns:
+            A :py:class:`mlflow.entities.webhook.Webhook` object representing the updated webhook
+            with all current properties including the changes made.
+
+        Raises:
+            mlflow.MlflowException: If the webhook with the specified ID does not exist, if the
+                provided parameters are invalid, or if there are permission issues accessing the webhook.
+
+        Example:
+
+            from mlflow import MlflowClient
+            from mlflow.entities.webhook import WebhookEvent, WebhookStatus
+
+            client = MlflowClient()
+
+            # Update webhook name and description
+            updated_webhook = client.update_webhook(
+                webhook_id="webhook_123",
+                name="Updated Model Registry Webhook",
+                description="Updated webhook for monitoring model registry events"
+            )
+
+            # Update webhook URL and events
+            updated_webhook = client.update_webhook(
+                webhook_id="webhook_123",
+                url="https://new-endpoint.example.com/webhook",
+                events=["model_version.created", "model_version.transitioned_stage"]
+            )
+
+            # Disable a webhook
+            updated_webhook = client.update_webhook(
+                webhook_id="webhook_123",
+                status="DISABLED"
+            )
+
+            # Update multiple properties at once
+            updated_webhook = client.update_webhook(
+                webhook_id="webhook_123",
+                name="Production Model Webhook",
+                url="https://prod-webhook.example.com/notify",
+                events=[WebhookEvent.MODEL_VERSION_CREATED, WebhookEvent.REGISTERED_MODEL_CREATED],
+                status=WebhookStatus.ACTIVE,
+                secret="new_secret_key"
+            )
+        """
+        return self._webhook_store.update_webhook(
+            webhook_id=webhook_id,
+            name=name,
+            description=description,
+            url=url,
+            events=events,
+            secret=secret,
+            status=status,
+        )

+"""
+MLflow Webhook entities: WebhookEvent, WebhookStatus, and Webhook.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import Optional
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Type alias used in signatures
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+WebhookEventStr = str  # e.g. "model_version.created"
+
+
+class WebhookStatus:
+    """Webhook status constants."""
+
+    ACTIVE = "ACTIVE"
+    DISABLED = "DISABLED"
+
+    _VALID = {ACTIVE, DISABLED}
+
+    def __init__(self, value: str):
+        value = value.upper()
+        if value not in self._VALID:
+            raise ValueError(f"Invalid WebhookStatus: {value!r}. Must be one of {self._VALID}")
+        self._value = value
+
+    @property
+    def value(self) -> str:
+        return self._value
+
+    def __str__(self) -> str:
+        return self._value
+
+    def __repr__(self) -> str:
+        return f"WebhookStatus({self._value!r})"
+
+    def __eq__(self, other: object) -> bool:
+        if isinstance(other, WebhookStatus):
+            return self._value == other._value
+        if isinstance(other, str):
+            return self._value == other.upper()
+        return NotImplemented
+
+    def __hash__(self) -> int:
+        return hash(self._value)
+
+    @classmethod
+    def from_string(cls, value: str) -> "WebhookStatus":
+        return cls(value)
+
+
+class WebhookEvent:
+    """
+    Represents a webhook event with a resource (entity) and action.
+
+    Predefined class-level constants cover the most common events.
+    Instances can also be created from "entity.action" strings.
+    """
+
+    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
+    # Predefined events
+    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
+    MODEL_VERSION_CREATED: "WebhookEvent"
+    MODEL_VERSION_TRANSITIONED_STAGE: "WebhookEvent"
+    MODEL_VERSION_DELETED: "WebhookEvent"
+    MODEL_VERSION_UPDATED: "WebhookEvent"
+    REGISTERED_MODEL_CREATED: "WebhookEvent"
+    REGISTERED_MODEL_DELETED: "WebhookEvent"
+    REGISTERED_MODEL_UPDATED: "WebhookEvent"
+    PROMPT_CREATED: "WebhookEvent"
+    PROMPT_DELETED: "WebhookEvent"
+    PROMPT_UPDATED: "WebhookEvent"
+
+    def __init__(self, entity: str, action: str):
+        self._entity = entity.lower()
+        self._action = action.lower()
+
+    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
+    # Properties
+    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
+    @property
+    def entity(self) -> str:
+        return self._entity
+
+    @property
+    def action(self) -> str:
+        return self._action
+
+    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
+    # String representation
+    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
+    def __str__(self) -> str:
+        return f"{self._entity}.{self._action}"
+
+    def __repr__(self) -> str:
+        return f"WebhookEvent({self._entity!r}, {self._action!r})"
+
+    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
+    # Equality / hashing
+    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
+    def __eq__(self, other: object) -> bool:
+        if not isinstance(other, WebhookEvent):
+            return False
+        return self._entity == other._entity and self._action == other._action
+
+    def __hash__(self) -> int:
+        return hash((self._entity, self._action))
+
+    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
+    # Factory helpers
+    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
+    @classmethod
+    def from_string(cls, event_str: str) -> "WebhookEvent":
+        """Parse an "entity.action" string into a WebhookEvent."""
+        parts = event_str.split(".", 1)
+        if len(parts) != 2:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"Invalid event string {event_str!r}. Expected format: 'entity.action'"
+            )
+        return cls(parts[0], parts[1])
+
+
+# Populate predefined class-level constants
+WebhookEvent.MODEL_VERSION_CREATED = WebhookEvent("model_version", "created")
+WebhookEvent.MODEL_VERSION_TRANSITIONED_STAGE = WebhookEvent("model_version", "transitioned_stage")
+WebhookEvent.MODEL_VERSION_DELETED = WebhookEvent("model_version", "deleted")
+WebhookEvent.MODEL_VERSION_UPDATED = WebhookEvent("model_version", "updated")
+WebhookEvent.REGISTERED_MODEL_CREATED = WebhookEvent("registered_model", "created")
+WebhookEvent.REGISTERED_MODEL_DELETED = WebhookEvent("registered_model", "deleted")
+WebhookEvent.REGISTERED_MODEL_UPDATED = WebhookEvent("registered_model", "updated")
+WebhookEvent.PROMPT_CREATED = WebhookEvent("prompt", "created")
+WebhookEvent.PROMPT_DELETED = WebhookEvent("prompt", "deleted")
+WebhookEvent.PROMPT_UPDATED = WebhookEvent("prompt", "updated")
+
+
+def _normalize_event(event) -> WebhookEvent:
+    """Convert a string or WebhookEvent to a WebhookEvent."""
+    if isinstance(event, WebhookEvent):
+        return event
+    if isinstance(event, str):
+        return WebhookEvent.from_string(event)
+    raise TypeError(f"Expected str or WebhookEvent, got {type(event)!r}")
+
+
+def _normalize_status(status) -> Optional[str]:
+    """Return the canonical status string or None."""
+    if status is None:
+        return None
+    if isinstance(status, WebhookStatus):
+        return status.value
+    if isinstance(status, str):
+        return WebhookStatus(status).value
+    raise TypeError(f"Expected str or WebhookStatus, got {type(status)!r}")
+
+
+class Webhook:
+    """
+    MLflow entity for Webhook.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        webhook_id: str,
+        name: str,
+        url: str,
+        events: list,
+        description: Optional[str] = None,
+        status: Optional[str] = None,
+        creation_timestamp: Optional[int] = None,
+        last_updated_timestamp: Optional[int] = None,
+    ):
+        self._id = webhook_id
+        self._name = name
+        self._url = url
+        self._events = [_normalize_event(e) for e in events]
+        self._description = description
+        self._status = status or WebhookStatus.ACTIVE
+        self._creation_timestamp = creation_timestamp
+        self._last_updated_timestamp = last_updated_timestamp
+
+    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
+    # Properties
+    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
+    @property
+    def id(self) -> str:
+        return self._id
+
+    @property
+    def name(self) -> str:
+        return self._name
+
+    @property
+    def url(self) -> str:
+        return self._url
+
+    @property
+    def events(self) -> list:
+        return list(self._events)
+
+    @property
+    def description(self) -> Optional[str]:
+        return self._description
+
+    @property
+    def status(self) -> str:
+        return self._status
+
+    @property
+    def creation_timestamp(self) -> Optional[int]:
+        return self._creation_timestamp
+
+    @property
+    def last_updated_timestamp(self) -> Optional[int]:
+        return self._last_updated_timestamp
+
+    @property
+    def secret(self) -> None:
+        """
+        The secret property always returns None for security reasons.
+
+        Secrets are stored securely in the backend for webhook signature
+        verification purposes, but they are never exposed through the Webhook
+        entity's secret property to prevent accidental disclosure.
+        """
+        return None
+
+    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
+    # Representation
+    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
+    def __repr__(self) -> str:
+        return (
+            f"Webhook(id={self._id!r}, name={self._name!r}, url={self._url!r}, "
+            f"events={self._events!r}, status={self._status!r})"
+        )
+
+    def __eq__(self, other: object) -> bool:
+        if not isinstance(other, Webhook):
+            return False
+        return self._id == other._id
+
+    def __hash__(self) -> int:
+        return hash(self._id)
+
+    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
+    # Serialisation helpers (used by the in-memory store)
+    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
+    def to_dict(self) -> dict:
+        return {
+            "id": self._id,
+            "name": self._name,
+            "url": self._url,
+            "events": [str(e) for e in self._events],
+            "description": self._description,
+            "status": self._status,
+            "creation_timestamp": self._creation_timestamp,
+            "last_updated_timestamp": self._last_updated_timestamp,
+        }
+

+"""
+PagedList: a list with an optional pagination token.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import Generic, Iterator, List, Optional, TypeVar
+
+T = TypeVar("T")
+
+
+class PagedList(list, Generic[T]):
+    """
+    A list subclass that carries an optional pagination token for the next page.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, items: List[T], token: Optional[str] = None):
+        super().__init__(items)
+        self._token = token
+
+    @property
+    def token(self) -> Optional[str]:
+        """Pagination token for the next page, or None if this is the last page."""
+        return self._token
+
+    def __repr__(self) -> str:
+        return f"PagedList({list.__repr__(self)}, token={self._token!r})"

+"""
+In-memory webhook store used by MlflowClient when no backend is configured.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import base64
+import time
+import uuid
+from typing import Dict, List, Optional
+
+from agent_code.entities.webhook import (
+    Webhook,
+    WebhookEvent,
+    WebhookStatus,
+    _normalize_event,
+    _normalize_status,
+)
+from agent_code.exceptions import MlflowException
+from agent_code.store.entities.paged_list import PagedList
+
+
+class InMemoryWebhookStore:
+    """Thread-unsafe in-memory store for webhooks (suitable for testing)."""
+
+    def __init__(self):
+        self._webhooks: Dict[str, dict] = {}
+
+    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
+    # Internal helpers
+    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
+    def _now_ms(self) -> int:
+        return int(time.time() * 1000)
+
+    def _new_id(self) -> str:
+        return str(uuid.uuid4())
+
+    def _get_or_raise(self, webhook_id: str) -> dict:
+        if webhook_id not in self._webhooks:
+            raise MlflowException(
+                f"Webhook with ID {webhook_id!r} not found.",
+                error_code="RESOURCE_DOES_NOT_EXIST",
+            )
+        return self._webhooks[webhook_id]
+
+    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
+    # CRUD
+    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
+    def create_webhook(
+        self,
+        name: str,
+        url: str,
+        events: list,
+        description: Optional[str] = None,
+        secret: Optional[str] = None,
+        status: Optional[str] = None,
+    ) -> Webhook:
+        now = self._now_ms()
+        wid = self._new_id()
+        normalized_events = [str(_normalize_event(e)) for e in events]
+        normalized_status = _normalize_status(status) or WebhookStatus.ACTIVE
+
+        record = {
+            "id": wid,
+            "name": name,
+            "url": url,
+            "events": normalized_events,
+            "description": description,
+            # secret is stored internally but never exposed via Webhook.secret
+            "_secret": secret,
+            "status": normalized_status,
+            "creation_timestamp": now,
+            "last_updated_timestamp": now,
+        }
+        self._webhooks[wid] = record
+        return self._to_webhook(record)
+
+    def get_webhook(self, webhook_id: str) -> Webhook:
+        record = self._get_or_raise(webhook_id)
+        return self._to_webhook(record)
+
+    def list_webhooks(
+        self,
+        max_results: Optional[int] = None,
+        page_token: Optional[str] = None,
+    ) -> PagedList:
+        all_webhooks = list(self._webhooks.values())
+
+        # Decode page offset from token
+        offset = 0
+        if page_token:
+            try:
+                offset = int(base64.b64decode(page_token.encode()).decode())
+            except Exception:
+                raise MlflowException(
+                    f"Invalid page_token: {page_token!r}",
+                    error_code="INVALID_PARAMETER_VALUE",
+                )
+
+        page = all_webhooks[offset:]
+        next_token = None
+
+        if max_results is not None and len(page) > max_results:
+            page = page[:max_results]
+            next_offset = offset + max_results
+            next_token = base64.b64encode(str(next_offset).encode()).decode()
+
+        return PagedList([self._to_webhook(r) for r in page], token=next_token)
+
+    def update_webhook(
+        self,
+        webhook_id: str,
+        name: Optional[str] = None,
+        description: Optional[str] = None,
+        url: Optional[str] = None,
+        events: Optional[list] = None,
+        secret: Optional[str] = None,
+        status=None,
+    ) -> Webhook:
+        record = self._get_or_raise(webhook_id)
+
+        if name is not None:
+            record["name"] = name
+        if description is not None:
+            record["description"] = description
+        if url is not None:
+            record["url"] = url
+        if events is not None:
+            record["events"] = [str(_normalize_event(e)) for e in events]
+        if secret is not None:
+            record["_secret"] = secret
+        if status is not None:
+            record["status"] = _normalize_status(status)
+
+        record["last_updated_timestamp"] = self._now_ms()
+        return self._to_webhook(record)
+
+    def delete_webhook(self, webhook_id: str) -> None:
+        self._get_or_raise(webhook_id)
+        del self._webhooks[webhook_id]
+
+    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
+    # Conversion
+    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
+    def _to_webhook(self, record: dict) -> Webhook:
+        return Webhook(
+            webhook_id=record["id"],
+            name=record["name"],
+            url=record["url"],
+            events=record.get("events", []),
+            description=record.get("description"),
+            status=record.get("status"),
+            creation_timestamp=record.get("creation_timestamp"),
+            last_updated_timestamp=record.get("last_updated_timestamp"),
+        )

+"""
+Utility decorators for agent_code.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import functools
+import warnings
+from typing import Callable, TypeVar
+
+F = TypeVar("F", bound=Callable)
+
+
+def experimental(version: str):
+    """
+    Decorator that marks a function or method as experimental.
+
+    Args:
+        version: The version in which the feature was introduced.
+
+    Returns:
+        A decorator that wraps the function with an experimental warning.
+    """
+
+    def decorator(func: F) -> F:
+        @functools.wraps(func)
+        def wrapper(*args, **kwargs):
+            return func(*args, **kwargs)
+
+        wrapper.__doc__ = (
+            f"[Experimental since version {version}]\n\n" + (func.__doc__ or "")
+        )
+        wrapper._experimental_version = version
+        return wrapper  # type: ignore[return-value]
+
+    return decorator

+"""
+MlflowClient: unified client for MLflow Tracking and Registry operations,
+including webhook management.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import List, Optional, Union
+
+from agent_code.entities.webhook import (
+    Webhook,
+    WebhookEvent,
+    WebhookEventStr,
+    WebhookStatus,
+)
+from agent_code.exceptions import MlflowException
+from agent_code.store.entities.paged_list import PagedList
+from agent_code.store.webhook.memory_store import InMemoryWebhookStore
+from agent_code.utils.decorators import experimental
+
+
+class MlflowClient:
+    """
+    Client of an MLflow Tracking Server that creates and manages experiments and runs, and of an
+    MLflow Registry Server that creates and manages registered models and model versions. It's a
+    thin wrapper around TrackingServiceClient and RegistryClient so there is a unified API but we
+    can keep the implementation of the tracking and registry clients independent from each other.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, tracking_uri: Optional[str] = None, registry_uri: Optional[str] = None):
+        self._tracking_uri = tracking_uri
+        self._registry_uri = registry_uri
+        # Use an in-memory store for webhook management
+        self._webhook_store = InMemoryWebhookStore()
+
+    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
+    # Webhook management
+    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+    @experimental(version="3.3.0")
+    def create_webhook(
+        self,
+        name: str,
+        url: str,
+        events: List[Union[WebhookEventStr, WebhookEvent]],
+        description: Optional[str] = None,
+        secret: Optional[str] = None,
+        status: Optional[Union[str, WebhookStatus]] = None,
+    ) -> Webhook:
+        """
+        Create a new webhook.
+
+        This method creates a webhook that will be triggered when specified MLflow events occur.
+        Webhooks allow you to receive HTTP notifications when events like model version creation,
+        transition, or deletion happen in your MLflow deployment.
+
+        Args:
+            name: Name for the webhook. This should be a descriptive identifier for the webhook.
+            url: Webhook endpoint URL where HTTP POST requests will be sent when events occur.
+                The URL must be accessible from the MLflow server.
+            events: List of events that trigger this webhook. Can be strings in "entity.action"
+                format (e.g., "model_version.created") or WebhookEvent objects. Common events include:
+                - "model_version.created": When a new model version is created
+                - "model_version.transitioned_stage": When a model version changes stage
+                - "registered_model.created": When a new registered model is created
+            description: Optional description of the webhook's purpose or functionality.
+            secret: Optional secret string used for HMAC-SHA256 signature verification. If provided,
+                MLflow will include an X-MLflow-Signature header in webhook requests that can be
+                used to verify the request authenticity.
+            status: Webhook status controlling whether the webhook is active. Can be a string
+                ("ACTIVE" or "DISABLED") or WebhookStatus enum value. Defaults to "ACTIVE" if not
+                specified. Disabled webhooks will not send HTTP requests.
+
+        Returns:
+            A Webhook object representing the created webhook, containing the webhook ID,
+            configuration details, and metadata like creation timestamp.
+
+        Raises:
+            MlflowException: If webhook creation fails due to invalid parameters, network issues,
+                or server-side errors. Common causes include invalid URL format, unsupported
+                event types, or insufficient permissions.
+
+        Example:
+
+            import mlflow
+            from mlflow import MlflowClient
+            from mlflow.entities.webhook import WebhookEvent
+
+            client = MlflowClient()
+
+            # Create a webhook for model version events
+            webhook = client.create_webhook(
+                name="model-deployment-webhook",
+                url="https://my-service.com/webhook",
+                events=["model_version.created", "model_version.transitioned_stage"],
+                description="Webhook for model deployment pipeline",
+                secret="my-secret-key",
+                status="ACTIVE"
+            )
+
+            print(f"Created webhook with ID: {webhook.id}")
+            print(f"Webhook status: {webhook.status}")
+
+            # Create webhook using WebhookEvent objects
+            webhook2 = client.create_webhook(
+                name="model-registry-webhook",
+                url="https://alerts.company.com/mlflow",
+                events=[
+                    WebhookEvent.REGISTERED_MODEL_CREATED,
+                    WebhookEvent.MODEL_VERSION_CREATED
+                ],
+                description="Alerts for new models and versions"
+            )
+        """
+        return self._webhook_store.create_webhook(
+            name=name,
+            url=url,
+            events=events,
+            description=description,
+            secret=secret,
+            status=status,
+        )
+
+    @experimental(version="3.3.0")
+    def delete_webhook(self, webhook_id: str) -> None:
+        """
+        Delete a webhook.
+
+        This method removes a webhook from the MLflow Model Registry. Once deleted, the webhook
+        will no longer receive notifications for the events it was configured to monitor.
+
+        Args:
+            webhook_id: The unique identifier of the webhook to delete. This ID is returned
+                when creating a webhook or can be obtained from listing webhooks.
+
+        Returns:
+            None
+
+        Raises:
+            MlflowException: If the webhook with the specified ID does not exist, if there
+                are permission issues, or if the deletion operation fails for any other reason.
+
+        Example:
+
+        .. code-block:: python
+
+            from mlflow import MlflowClient
+
+            client = MlflowClient()
+
+            # Create a webhook first
+            webhook = client.create_webhook(
+                name="test-webhook",
+                url="https://example.com/webhook",
+                events=["model_version.created"]
+            )
+
+            # Delete the webhook
+            client.delete_webhook(webhook.id)
+
+            # Verify deletion by trying to get the webhook (this will raise an exception)
+            try:
+                client.get_webhook(webhook.id)
+            except MlflowException:
+                print("Webhook successfully deleted")
+        """
+        self._webhook_store.delete_webhook(webhook_id)
+
+    @experimental(version="3.3.0")
+    def get_webhook(self, webhook_id: str) -> Webhook:
+        """
+        Get webhook instance by ID.
+
+        Args:
+            webhook_id: Webhook ID.
+
+        Returns:
+            A :py:class:`mlflow.entities.webhook.Webhook` object.
+
+        Raises:
+            mlflow.MlflowException: If the webhook with the specified ID does not exist or if there
+                are permission issues accessing the webhook.
+
+        Example:
+
+        .. code-block:: python
+            :caption: Example
+
+            from mlflow import MlflowClient
+
+            client = MlflowClient()
+
+            # Get an existing webhook by ID
+            webhook = client.get_webhook("webhook_123")
+
+            print(f"Webhook name: {webhook.name}")
+            print(f"Webhook URL: {webhook.url}")
+            print(f"Webhook status: {webhook.status}")
+            print(f"Webhook events: {webhook.events}")
+        """
+        return self._webhook_store.get_webhook(webhook_id)
+
+    @experimental(version="3.3.0")
+    def list_webhooks(
+        self,
+        max_results: Optional[int] = None,
+        page_token: Optional[str] = None,
+    ) -> PagedList:
+        """
+        List webhooks.
+
+        Args:
+            max_results: Maximum number of webhooks to return.
+            page_token: Token specifying the next page of results.
+
+        Returns:
+            A :py:class:`mlflow.store.entities.paged_list.PagedList` of Webhook objects.
+        """
+        return self._webhook_store.list_webhooks(
+            max_results=max_results,
+            page_token=page_token,
+        )
+
+    @experimental(version="3.3.0")
+    def update_webhook(
+        self,
+        webhook_id: str,
+        name: Optional[str] = None,
+        description: Optional[str] = None,
+        url: Optional[str] = None,
+        events: Optional[List[Union[WebhookEventStr, WebhookEvent]]] = None,
+        secret: Optional[str] = None,
+        status: Optional[Union[str, WebhookStatus]] = None,
+    ) -> Webhook:
+        """
+        Update an existing webhook.
+
+        This method allows you to modify various properties of an existing webhook including its name,
+        description, URL, events, secret, and status. Only the fields you specify will be updated;
+        other fields will remain unchanged.
+
+        Args:
+            webhook_id: The unique identifier of the webhook to update.
+            name: New name for the webhook. If None, the current name is preserved.
+            description: New description for the webhook. If None, the current description is preserved.
+            url: New endpoint URL for the webhook. If None, the current URL is preserved.
+            events: New list of events that should trigger this webhook. Can be a list of strings
+                in "entity.action" format (e.g., "model_version.created") or WebhookEvent objects.
+                If None, the current events are preserved.
+            secret: New secret for HMAC signature verification. If None, the current secret is preserved.
+                Pass an empty string to remove the secret.
+            status: New status for the webhook. Can be a string ("ACTIVE" or "DISABLED") or a
+                WebhookStatus enum value. If None, the current status is preserved.
+
+        Returns:
+            A :py:class:`mlflow.entities.webhook.Webhook` object representing the updated webhook
+            with all current properties including the changes made.
+
+        Raises:
+            mlflow.MlflowException: If the webhook with the specified ID does not exist, if the
+                provided parameters are invalid, or if there are permission issues accessing the webhook.
+
+        Example:
+
+            from mlflow import MlflowClient
+            from mlflow.entities.webhook import WebhookEvent, WebhookStatus
+
+            client = MlflowClient()
+
+            # Update webhook name and description
+            updated_webhook = client.update_webhook(
+                webhook_id="webhook_123",
+                name="Updated Model Registry Webhook",
+                description="Updated webhook for monitoring model registry events"
+            )
+
+            # Update webhook URL and events
+            updated_webhook = client.update_webhook(
+                webhook_id="webhook_123",
+                url="https://new-endpoint.example.com/webhook",
+                events=["model_version.created", "model_version.transitioned_stage"]
+            )
+
+            # Disable a webhook
+            updated_webhook = client.update_webhook(
+                webhook_id="webhook_123",
+                status="DISABLED"
+            )
+
+            # Update multiple properties at once
+            updated_webhook = client.update_webhook(
+                webhook_id="webhook_123",
+                name="Production Model Webhook",
+                url="https://prod-webhook.example.com/notify",
+                events=[WebhookEvent.MODEL_VERSION_CREATED, WebhookEvent.REGISTERED_MODEL_CREATED],
+                status=WebhookStatus.ACTIVE,
+                secret="new_secret_key"
+            )
+        """

+"""
+MLflow Webhook entities: WebhookEvent, WebhookStatus, and Webhook.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import Optional
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Type alias used in signatures
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+WebhookEventStr = str  # e.g. "model_version.created"
+
+
+class WebhookStatus:
+    """Webhook status constants."""
+
+    ACTIVE = "ACTIVE"
+    DISABLED = "DISABLED"
+
+    _VALID = {ACTIVE, DISABLED}
+
+    def __init__(self, value: str):
+        value = value.upper()
+        if value not in self._VALID:
+            raise ValueError(f"Invalid WebhookStatus: {value!r}. Must be one of {self._VALID}")
+        self._value = value
+

+        if isinstance(other, WebhookStatus):

+        if isinstance(other, str):
+            return self._value == other.upper()
+        return NotImplemented
+
+    def __hash__(self) -> int:
+        return hash(self._value)

+    @classmethod

+class WebhookEvent:
+    """
+    Represents a webhook event with a resource (entity) and action.
+
+    Predefined class-level constants cover the most common events.
+    Instances can also be created from "entity.action" strings.
+    """
+
+    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
+    # Predefined events
+    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
+    MODEL_VERSION_CREATED: "WebhookEvent"
+    MODEL_VERSION_TRANSITIONED_STAGE: "WebhookEvent"
+    MODEL_VERSION_DELETED: "WebhookEvent"
+    MODEL_VERSION_UPDATED: "WebhookEvent"
+    REGISTERED_MODEL_CREATED: "WebhookEvent"
+    REGISTERED_MODEL_DELETED: "WebhookEvent"
+    REGISTERED_MODEL_UPDATED: "WebhookEvent"
+    PROMPT_CREATED: "WebhookEvent"
+    PROMPT_DELETED: "WebhookEvent"
+    PROMPT_UPDATED: "WebhookEvent"
+
+    def __init__(self, entity: str, action: str):
+        self._entity = entity.lower()
+        self._action = action.lower()
+
+    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
+    # Properties
+    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
+    @property
+    def entity(self) -> str:
+        return self._entity
+
+    @property
+    def action(self) -> str:
+        return self._action
+
+    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
+    # String representation
+    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
+    def __str__(self) -> str:
+        return f"{self._entity}.{self._action}"
+
+    def __repr__(self) -> str:
+        return f"WebhookEvent({self._entity!r}, {self._action!r})"
+
+    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
+    # Equality / hashing
+    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
+    def __eq__(self, other: object) -> bool:
+        if not isinstance(other, WebhookEvent):
+            return False
+        return self._entity == other._entity and self._action == other._action
+
+    def __hash__(self) -> int:
+        return hash((self._entity, self._action))
+
+    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
+    # Factory helpers
+    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
+    @classmethod
+    def from_string(cls, event_str: str) -> "WebhookEvent":
+        """Parse an "entity.action" string into a WebhookEvent."""
+        parts = event_str.split(".", 1)
+        if len(parts) != 2:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"Invalid event string {event_str!r}. Expected format: 'entity.action'"
+            )
+        return cls(parts[0], parts[1])

+WebhookEvent.MODEL_VERSION_CREATED = WebhookEvent("model_version", "created")
+WebhookEvent.MODEL_VERSION_TRANSITIONED_STAGE = WebhookEvent("model_version", "transitioned_stage")
+WebhookEvent.MODEL_VERSION_DELETED = WebhookEvent("model_version", "deleted")
+WebhookEvent.MODEL_VERSION_UPDATED = WebhookEvent("model_version", "updated")

+WebhookEvent.PROMPT_DELETED = WebhookEvent("prompt", "deleted")
+WebhookEvent.PROMPT_UPDATED = WebhookEvent("prompt", "updated")

+
+def _normalize_event(event) -> WebhookEvent:
+    """Convert a string or WebhookEvent to a WebhookEvent."""

+    if isinstance(event, str):
+        return WebhookEvent.from_string(event)

+        self._status = status or WebhookStatus.ACTIVE
+        self._creation_timestamp = creation_timestamp
+        self._last_updated_timestamp = last_updated_timestamp

+    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
+    # Properties
+    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

+    def id(self) -> str:

+    @property

+
+    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

+"""
+PagedList: a list with an optional pagination token.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import Generic, Iterator, List, Optional, TypeVar
+
+T = TypeVar("T")
+
+
+class PagedList(list, Generic[T]):
+    """
+    A list subclass that carries an optional pagination token for the next page.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, items: List[T], token: Optional[str] = None):
+        super().__init__(items)
+        self._token = token
+
+    @property
+    def token(self) -> Optional[str]:
+        """Pagination token for the next page, or None if this is the last page."""
+        return self._token
+
+    def __repr__(self) -> str:
+        return f"PagedList({list.__repr__(self)}, token={self._token!r})"

+"""
+In-memory webhook store used by MlflowClient when no backend is configured.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import base64
+import time
+import uuid
+from typing import Dict, List, Optional
+
+from agent_code.entities.webhook import (
+    Webhook,
+    WebhookEvent,
+    WebhookStatus,
+    _normalize_event,
+    _normalize_status,
+)
+from agent_code.exceptions import MlflowException
+from agent_code.store.entities.paged_list import PagedList
+
+
+class InMemoryWebhookStore:
+    """Thread-unsafe in-memory store for webhooks (suitable for testing)."""
+
+    def __init__(self):
+        self._webhooks: Dict[str, dict] = {}
+
+    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
+    # Internal helpers
+    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
+    def _now_ms(self) -> int:
+        return int(time.time() * 1000)
+
+    def _new_id(self) -> str:
+        return str(uuid.uuid4())
+
+    def _get_or_raise(self, webhook_id: str) -> dict:
+        if webhook_id not in self._webhooks:
+            raise MlflowException(
+                f"Webhook with ID {webhook_id!r} not found.",
+                error_code="RESOURCE_DOES_NOT_EXIST",
+            )
+        return self._webhooks[webhook_id]
+
+    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
+    # CRUD
+    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
+    def create_webhook(
+        self,
+        name: str,
+        url: str,
+        events: list,
+        description: Optional[str] = None,
+        secret: Optional[str] = None,
+        status: Optional[str] = None,
+    ) -> Webhook:
+        now = self._now_ms()
+        wid = self._new_id()
+        normalized_events = [str(_normalize_event(e)) for e in events]
+        normalized_status = _normalize_status(status) or WebhookStatus.ACTIVE
+
+        record = {
+            "id": wid,
+            "name": name,
+            "url": url,
+            "events": normalized_events,
+            "description": description,
+            # secret is stored internally but never exposed via Webhook.secret
+            "_secret": secret,
+            "status": normalized_status,
+            "creation_timestamp": now,
+            "last_updated_timestamp": now,
+        }
+        self._webhooks[wid] = record
+        return self._to_webhook(record)
+
+    def get_webhook(self, webhook_id: str) -> Webhook:
+        record = self._get_or_raise(webhook_id)
+        return self._to_webhook(record)
+
+    def list_webhooks(
+        self,
+        max_results: Optional[int] = None,
+        page_token: Optional[str] = None,
+    ) -> PagedList:
+        all_webhooks = list(self._webhooks.values())
+
+        # Decode page offset from token
+        offset = 0
+        if page_token:
+            try:
+                offset = int(base64.b64decode(page_token.encode()).decode())
+            except Exception:
+                raise MlflowException(
+                    f"Invalid page_token: {page_token!r}",
+                    error_code="INVALID_PARAMETER_VALUE",
+                )
+
+        page = all_webhooks[offset:]
+        next_token = None
+
+        if max_results is not None and len(page) > max_results:
+            page = page[:max_results]
+            next_offset = offset + max_results
+            next_token = base64.b64encode(str(next_offset).encode()).decode()
+
+        return PagedList([self._to_webhook(r) for r in page], token=next_token)
+
+    def update_webhook(
+        self,
+        webhook_id: str,
+        name: Optional[str] = None,
+        description: Optional[str] = None,
+        url: Optional[str] = None,
+        events: Optional[list] = None,
+        secret: Optional[str] = None,
+        status=None,
+    ) -> Webhook:
+        record = self._get_or_raise(webhook_id)
+
+        if name is not None:
+            record["name"] = name
+        if description is not None:
+            record["description"] = description
+        if url is not None:
+            record["url"] = url
+        if events is not None:
+            record["events"] = [str(_normalize_event(e)) for e in events]
+        if secret is not None:
+            record["_secret"] = secret
+        if status is not None:
+            record["status"] = _normalize_status(status)
+
+        record["last_updated_timestamp"] = self._now_ms()
+        return self._to_webhook(record)
+
+    def delete_webhook(self, webhook_id: str) -> None:
+        self._get_or_raise(webhook_id)
+        del self._webhooks[webhook_id]
+
+    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
+    # Conversion
+    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
+    def _to_webhook(self, record: dict) -> Webhook:
+        return Webhook(
+            webhook_id=record["id"],
+            name=record["name"],
+            url=record["url"],
+            events=record.get("events", []),
+            description=record.get("description"),
+            status=record.get("status"),
+            creation_timestamp=record.get("creation_timestamp"),
+            last_updated_timestamp=record.get("last_updated_timestamp"),
+        )

+"""
+Utility decorators for agent_code.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import functools
+import warnings
+from typing import Callable, TypeVar
+
+F = TypeVar("F", bound=Callable)
+
+
+def experimental(version: str):
+    """
+    Decorator that marks a function or method as experimental.
+
+    Args:
+        version: The version in which the feature was introduced.
+
+    Returns:
+        A decorator that wraps the function with an experimental warning.
+    """
+
+    def decorator(func: F) -> F:
+        @functools.wraps(func)
+        def wrapper(*args, **kwargs):
+            return func(*args, **kwargs)
+
+        wrapper.__doc__ = (
+            f"[Experimental since version {version}]\n\n" + (func.__doc__ or "")
+        )
+        wrapper._experimental_version = version
+        return wrapper  # type: ignore[return-value]
+
+    return decorator

+"""
+AI Command Management Utilities for MLflow.
+
+Provides functionality to discover, parse, and retrieve AI commands stored as
+markdown files with YAML frontmatter.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import os
+import re
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+import yaml
+
+# The "commands directory" is the parent directory of this module file,
+# i.e., agent_code/ itself.
+_COMMANDS_DIR = Path(__file__).parent
+
+
+def parse_frontmatter(content: str) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], str]:
+    """
+    Parse YAML frontmatter from markdown content and separate it from the body.
+
+    Args:
+        content: The markdown content string that may contain YAML frontmatter
+                 at the beginning. Frontmatter should be delimited by '---' on
+                 separate lines.
+
+    Returns:
+        tuple[dict[str, Any], str]: A tuple containing:
+            - dict: The parsed YAML frontmatter as a dictionary. Returns empty dict
+                   if no frontmatter is found or if YAML parsing fails.
+            - str: The remaining markdown content after removing the frontmatter.
+                  Returns the original content if no frontmatter is detected.
+    """
+    pattern = re.compile(r'^---\s*\n(.*?)\n---\s*\n?(.*)', re.DOTALL)
+    match = pattern.match(content)
+    if not match:
+        return {}, content
+
+    frontmatter_str = match.group(1)
+    body = match.group(2)
+
+    try:
+        metadata = yaml.safe_load(frontmatter_str) or {}
+    except yaml.YAMLError:
+        return {}, content
+
+    if not isinstance(metadata, dict):
+        metadata = {}
+
+    return metadata, body
+
+
+def _commands_dir() -> Path:
+    """Return the commands directory path."""
+    return _COMMANDS_DIR
+
+
+def get_command(key: str) -> str:
+    """
+    Get command content by key.
+
+    Args:
+        key: Command key identifier using forward slash notation
+             (e.g., 'genai/analyze_experiment').
+
+    Returns:
+        str: The complete markdown content of the command file.
+
+    Raises:
+        FileNotFoundError: If the command file does not exist.
+    """
+    # Convert forward slashes to OS-specific separators
+    relative_path = key.replace("/", os.sep)
+    file_path = _commands_dir() / (relative_path + ".md")
+
+    if not file_path.exists():
+        raise FileNotFoundError(
+            f"Command file not found for key '{key}': {file_path}"
+        )
+
+    return file_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+
+
+def get_command_body(key: str) -> str:
+    """
+    Get command body content without frontmatter.
+
+    Args:
+        key: Command key identifying the command file
+             (e.g., 'genai/analyze_experiment').
+
+    Returns:
+        Command body content as a string with YAML frontmatter removed.
+
+    Raises:
+        FileNotFoundError: If the command file does not exist.
+    """
+    content = get_command(key)
+    _, body = parse_frontmatter(content)
+    return body
+
+
+def list_commands(namespace: str | None = None) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    """
+    List all available MLflow commands with their metadata.
+
+    Args:
+        namespace: Optional namespace string to filter commands. If provided,
+                   only commands whose keys start with "{namespace}/" will be
+                   included.
+
+    Returns:
+        A list of dictionaries sorted alphabetically by key, each containing:
+        - "key": Command identifier (e.g., "genai/analyze_experiment")
+        - "namespace": Namespace from frontmatter (empty string if not specified)
+        - "description": Description from frontmatter ("No description" if not specified)
+    """
+    commands_dir = _commands_dir()
+
+    if not commands_dir.exists():
+        return []
+
+    results = []
+
+    for md_file in commands_dir.rglob("*.md"):
+        try:
+            content = md_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+        except Exception:
+            continue
+
+        try:
+            metadata, _ = parse_frontmatter(content)
+        except Exception:
+            metadata = {}
+
+        # Build the key: relative path from commands_dir without .md extension,
+        # using forward slashes regardless of OS.
+        relative = md_file.relative_to(commands_dir)
+        key = str(relative.with_suffix("")).replace(os.sep, "/")
+
+        if namespace is not None and not key.startswith(f"{namespace}/"):
+            continue
+
+        results.append(
+            {
+                "key": key,
+                "namespace": metadata.get("namespace", ""),
+                "description": metadata.get("description", "No description"),
+            }
+        )
+
+    results.sort(key=lambda x: x["key"])
+    return results

+    def decorator(func):

+    return decorator
+

+def _import_optional_dependency(name: str):
+    """
+    Import an optional dependency, raising ImportError with a helpful message
+    if it is not installed.
+    """
+    import importlib
+    try:
+        return importlib.import_module(name)
+    except ImportError:
+        raise ImportError(
+            f"Missing optional dependency '{name}'. "
+            f"Use pip or conda to install {name.split('.')[0]}."
+        ) from None
+
+
+@_set_module("pandas")
+def read_iceberg(
+    table_identifier: str,
+    catalog_name: str | None = None,
+    *,
+    catalog_properties: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
+    row_filter: str | None = None,
+    selected_fields: tuple[str, ...] | None = None,
+    case_sensitive: bool = True,
+    snapshot_id: int | None = None,
+    limit: int | None = None,
+    scan_properties: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
+):
+    """
+    Read an Apache Iceberg table into a pandas DataFrame.
+
+    .. versionadded:: 3.0.0
+
+    .. warning::
+
+       read_iceberg is experimental and may change without warning.
+
+    Parameters
+    ----------
+    table_identifier : str
+        Table identifier specifying the Iceberg table to read.
+    catalog_name : str, optional
+        The name of the catalog containing the table.
+    catalog_properties : dict of {str: Any}, optional
+        Additional properties used for catalog configuration.
+    row_filter : str, optional
+        A filter expression string to specify which rows to include.
+    selected_fields : tuple of str, optional
+        A tuple of column names to include in the output DataFrame.
+    case_sensitive : bool, default True
+        Whether column name matching should be case sensitive.
+    snapshot_id : int, optional
+        Specific snapshot ID to read from for time travel queries.
+    limit : int, optional
+        Maximum number of rows to return.
+    scan_properties : dict of {str: Any}, optional
+        Additional properties to configure the table scan operation.
+
+    Returns
+    -------
+    DataFrame
+        A pandas DataFrame containing the data from the Iceberg table.
+
+    Raises
+    ------
+    ImportError
+        If the required pyiceberg dependency is not installed.
+    ValueError
+        If the table_identifier is invalid or the table cannot be found.
+    """
+    # Import required pyiceberg modules (raises ImportError if not installed)
+    iceberg_catalog = _import_optional_dependency("pyiceberg.catalog")
+    iceberg_expressions = _import_optional_dependency("pyiceberg.expressions")
+
+    # Apply default value transformations
+    if catalog_properties is None:
+        catalog_properties = {}
+    if scan_properties is None:
+        scan_properties = {}
+    if selected_fields is None:
+        selected_fields = ("*",)
+    if row_filter is None:
+        row_filter = iceberg_expressions.AlwaysTrue()
+
+    # Load the catalog

+
+    # Load the table
+    table = catalog.load_table(table_identifier)
+
+    # Perform the scan

+        row_filter=row_filter,
+        selected_fields=selected_fields,
+        case_sensitive=case_sensitive,
+        snapshot_id=snapshot_id,
+        limit=limit,
+        options=scan_properties,
+    )
+
+    # Convert to pandas DataFrame
+    return scan.to_pandas()

+def _lookup_by_attr_factory(attr, unique, iter_method, element_name, doc):
+    """
+    Factory function to create lookup methods for VOTable elements by attribute.
+    
+    Parameters
+    ----------
+    attr : str
+        The attribute name to look up by.
+    unique : bool
+        If True, only one match is expected and the first match is returned.
+        If False, an iterator of all matches is returned.
+    iter_method : str
+        The name of the iterator method to use.
+    element_name : str
+        The name of the element type being looked up (for error messages).
+    doc : str
+        The docstring for the generated method.
+    
+    Returns
+    -------
+    function
+        A lookup function.
+    """
+    def lookup(self, value, before=None):
+        for element in getattr(self, iter_method)():
+            if getattr(element, attr, None) == value:
+                if unique:
+                    return element
+                else:
+                    yield element
+        if unique:
+            return None
+    
+    if unique:
+        def lookup_unique(self, value, before=None):
+            for element in getattr(self, iter_method)():
+                if getattr(element, attr, None) == value:
+                    return element
+            return None
+        lookup_unique.__doc__ = doc
+        return lookup_unique
+    else:
+        def lookup_all(self, value, before=None):
+            for element in getattr(self, iter_method)():
+                if getattr(element, attr, None) == value:
+                    yield element
+        lookup_all.__doc__ = doc
+        return lookup_all
+

+def _lookup_by_id_or_name_factory(iter_method, element_name, doc):
+    """
+    Factory function to create lookup methods for VOTable elements by ID or name.

+    Parameters

+    iter_method : str

+    doc : str
+        The docstring for the generated method.
+    
+    Returns
+    -------
+    function
+        A lookup function.
+    """
+    def lookup(self, ref, before=None):
+        for element in getattr(self, iter_method)():
+            if getattr(element, 'ID', None) == ref:
+                return element
+            if getattr(element, 'name', None) == ref:
+                return element
+        return None
+    
+    lookup.__doc__ = doc

+        If the VOTable version is earlier than 1.3, attempting to set this format
+        will raise an exception.
+        
+        Examples
+        --------
+        Set all tables to use the binary format:
+        
+            >>> votable.set_all_tables_format('binary')
+        
+        Set all tables to use human-readable tabledata format:
+        
+            >>> votable.set_all_tables_format('tabledata')
+        """
+        for table in self.iter_tables():
+            table.format = format
+    
+    def iter_tables(self):
+        """Iterate over all TABLE elements recursively."""
+        for resource in self.resources:
+            yield from resource.iter_tables()
+    
+    def iter_fields_and_params(self):
+        """Iterate over all FIELD and PARAM elements recursively."""
+        for param in self.params:
+            yield param
+        for resource in self.resources:
+            yield from resource.iter_fields_and_params()
+    
+    def iter_groups(self):
+        """Iterate over all GROUP elements recursively."""
+        for group in self.groups:
+            yield group
+        for resource in self.resources:
+            yield from resource.iter_groups()
+    
+    def iter_info(self):
+        """Iterate over all INFO elements recursively."""
+        for info in self.infos:
+            yield info
+        for resource in self.resources:
+            yield from resource.iter_info()
+    
+    def iter_coosys(self):
+        """Iterate over all COOSYS elements recursively."""
+        for coosys in self.coosys:
+            yield coosys
+        for resource in self.resources:
+            yield from resource.iter_coosys()
+    
+    def iter_timesys(self):
+        """Iterate over all TIMESYS elements recursively."""
+        for ts in self.timesys:
+            yield ts
+        for resource in self.resources:
+            yield from resource.iter_timesys()
+    
+    def iter_values(self):
+        """Iterate over all VALUES elements recursively."""
+        for table in self.iter_tables():
+            for field in table.fields:
+                if field.values is not None:
+                    yield field.values
+    
+    def to_xml(self, fd, tabledata_format=None):
+        """
+        Write the VOTable to an XML file.
+        
+        Parameters
+        ----------
+        fd : file-like object or str
+            The file to write to.
+        tabledata_format : str, optional
+            The format to use for table data.
+        """
+        # Basic XML output implementation
+        import io
+        
+        if isinstance(fd, str):
+            with open(fd, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
+                self._write_xml(f)
+        else:
+            self._write_xml(fd)
+    
+    def _write_xml(self, fd):
+        """Write the VOTable XML to a file-like object."""
+        version = self._version
+        ns_info = self._version_namespace_map['_value'].get(version, 
+                  self._version_namespace_map['_value']['1.4'])
+        
+        namespace_uri = ns_info['namespace_uri']
+        schema_location_attr = ns_info['schema_location_attr']
+        schema_location_value = ns_info['schema_location_value']
+        
+        fd.write('<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>\n')
+        fd.write(
+            f'<VOTABLE version="{version}" '
+            f'xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" '
+            f'xmlns="{namespace_uri}" '
+            f'{schema_location_attr}="{schema_location_value}">\n'
+        )
+        
+        if self._description:
+            fd.write(f'  <DESCRIPTION>{self._description}</DESCRIPTION>\n')
+        
+        for resource in self.resources:
+            self._write_resource(fd, resource, indent='  ')
+        
+        fd.write('</VOTABLE>\n')
+    
+    def _write_resource(self, fd, resource, indent=''):
+        """Write a RESOURCE element."""
+        attrs = ''
+        if resource.name:
+            attrs += f' name="{resource.name}"'
+        if resource._ID:
+            attrs += f' ID="{resource._ID}"'
+        if resource.type:
+            attrs += f' type="{resource.type}"'
+        
+        fd.write(f'{indent}<RESOURCE{attrs}>\n')
+        
+        if resource._description:
+            fd.write(f'{indent}  <DESCRIPTION>{resource._description}</DESCRIPTION>\n')
+        
+        for table in resource.tables:
+            self._write_table(fd, table, indent=indent + '  ')
+        
+        for sub_resource in resource.resources:
+            self._write_resource(fd, sub_resource, indent=indent + '  ')
+        
+        fd.write(f'{indent}</RESOURCE>\n')
+    
+    def _write_table(self, fd, table, indent=''):
+        """Write a TABLE element."""
+        attrs = ''
+        if table.name:
+            attrs += f' name="{table.name}"'
+        if table._ID:
+            attrs += f' ID="{table._ID}"'
+        
+        fd.write(f'{indent}<TABLE{attrs}>\n')
+        
+        if table._description:
+            fd.write(f'{indent}  <DESCRIPTION>{table._description}</DESCRIPTION>\n')
+        
+        for field in table.fields:
+            self._write_field(fd, field, indent=indent + '  ')
+        
+        fd.write(f'{indent}  <DATA>\n')
+        
+        fmt = table.format.upper()
+        if fmt == 'TABLEDATA':
+            fd.write(f'{indent}    <TABLEDATA>\n')
+            fd.write(f'{indent}    </TABLEDATA>\n')
+        elif fmt == 'BINARY':
+            fd.write(f'{indent}    <BINARY>\n')
+            fd.write(f'{indent}      <STREAM encoding="base64"></STREAM>\n')
+            fd.write(f'{indent}    </BINARY>\n')
+        elif fmt == 'BINARY2':
+            fd.write(f'{indent}    <BINARY2>\n')
+            fd.write(f'{indent}      <STREAM encoding="base64"></STREAM>\n')
+            fd.write(f'{indent}    </BINARY2>\n')
+        
+        fd.write(f'{indent}  </DATA>\n')
+        fd.write(f'{indent}</TABLE>\n')
+    
+    def _write_field(self, fd, field, indent=''):
+        """Write a FIELD element."""
+        attrs = ''
+        if field.name:
+            attrs += f' name="{field.name}"'
+        if field._ID:
+            attrs += f' ID="{field._ID}"'
+        if field.datatype:
+            attrs += f' datatype="{field.datatype}"'
+        if field.arraysize:
+            attrs += f' arraysize="{field.arraysize}"'
+        if field.unit:
+            attrs += f' unit="{field.unit}"'
+        if field.ucd:
+            attrs += f' ucd="{field.ucd}"'
+        
+        fd.write(f'{indent}<FIELD{attrs}/>\n')
+    
+    @classmethod
+    def from_table(cls, table, table_id=None):
+        """
+        Create a VOTableFile from an Astropy Table.
+        
+        Parameters
+        ----------
+        table : astropy.table.Table
+            The table to convert.
+        table_id : str, optional
+            The ID to assign to the TABLE element.
+        
+        Returns
+        -------
+        VOTableFile
+            A new VOTableFile containing the table data.
+        """
+        votable = cls()
+        resource = Resource()
+        votable.resources.append(resource)
+        
+        t = Table(votable)
+        if table_id:
+            t._ID = table_id
+        resource.tables.append(t)
+        
+        return votable

+"""
+Utility functions for VOTable parsing and validation.
+"""
+
+import re
+
+from .exceptions import (
+    W07, W08,
+    warn_or_raise,
+)
+
+
+def check_token(token):
+    """
+    Returns `True` if *token* is a valid XML token, as defined by XML Schema Part 2.
+    
+    An XML token is a string that:
+    - Can be empty
+    - Contains no carriage return (\\r), line feed (\\n), or tab (\\t) characters
+    - Has no leading or trailing spaces
+    - May contain internal spaces, but not consecutive spaces at the beginning or end
+    
+    Parameters
+    ----------
+    token : str
+        The string to validate as an XML token
+    
+    Returns
+    -------
+    bool
+        True if the token is valid according to XML Schema Part 2 token rules,
+        False otherwise
+    
+    Notes
+    -----
+    This function implements the XML Schema Part 2 definition of a token, which is
+    more restrictive than a general XML string. The validation ensures that the
+    token contains no line breaks, tabs, leading/trailing whitespace, and follows
+    the proper whitespace normalization rules for XML tokens.
+    """
+    if token is None:
+        return False
+    
+    # Check for carriage return, line feed, or tab characters
+    if '\r' in token or '\n' in token or '\t' in token:
+        return False
+    
+    # Check for leading or trailing spaces
+    if token != token.strip():
+        return False
+    
+    # Check for consecutive internal spaces (double spaces)
+    if '  ' in token:
+        return False
+    
+    return True
+
+
+def check_astroyear(year, field, config=None, pos=None):
+    """
+    Validates that a given string represents a valid astronomical year according to the VOTable specification.
+    
+    Parameters
+    ----------
+    year : str or None
+        The astronomical year string to validate. Can be None, in which case
+        validation passes. Valid formats include:
+        - Plain numbers: "2000", "1950.5"
+        - Julian years: "J2000", "J1950.5"
+        - Besselian years: "B1950", "B1900.0"
+    
+    field : str
+        The name of the field or attribute where this year value was found.
+        Used in error messages to provide context about the source of the
+        invalid value.
+    
+    config : dict, optional
+        Configuration dictionary containing parsing options and version
+        information. Used to determine how strictly to enforce validation
+        and whether to raise exceptions or warnings.
+    
+    pos : tuple, optional
+        Position information (line, column) in the source document where
+        this value was found. Used for generating informative error messages.
+    
+    Returns
+    -------
+    bool
+        True if the year is valid or None, False if the year is invalid.
+        When False is returned, a warning or exception will also be issued
+        depending on the verification settings in config.
+    
+    Notes
+    -----
+    The function validates astronomical years using a regular expression that
+    matches the pattern: optional prefix (J or B), followed by digits, optionally
+    followed by a decimal point and more digits. This covers standard astronomical
+    year formats used in coordinate systems and epoch specifications.
+    
+    If validation fails, the function will either raise a VOTableSpecError or
+    issue a warning, depending on the 'verify' setting in the config parameter.
+    The specific warning issued is W07.
+    
+    Examples
+    --------
+    Valid astronomical years include:
+    - "2000" (plain year)
+    - "2000.0" (year with decimal)
+    - "J2000" (Julian year)
+    - "B1950.5" (Besselian year with decimal)
+    
+    Invalid formats would be:
+    - "2000AD" (contains non-numeric suffix)
+    - "J" (missing year number)
+    - "2000.5.0" (multiple decimal points)
+    """
+    if year is None:
+        return True
+    
+    # Pattern: optional J or B prefix, followed by digits, optionally followed by
+    # a decimal point and more digits
+    _astroyear_re = re.compile(r'^[JB]?\d+(\.\d+)?$')
+    
+    if not _astroyear_re.match(year):
+        warn_or_raise(W07, W07, (field, year), config, pos)
+        return False
+    
+    return True
+
+
+def check_string(string, attr_name, config=None, pos=None):
+    """
+    Validates that a given value is a string type and raises appropriate warnings or errors if not.
+    
+    This function is used throughout the VOTable parsing process to ensure that string attributes
+    and values conform to the expected string type requirements of the VOTable specification.
+    
+    Parameters
+    ----------
+    string : any
+        The value to be validated as a string. Should be a string or Unicode string,
+        but can be any type for validation purposes.
+    attr_name : str
+        The name of the attribute or field being validated. Used in error/warning
+        messages to provide context about where the invalid value was encountered.
+    config : dict, optional
+        Configuration dictionary that controls validation behavior and error handling.
+        If None, default validation settings are used.
+    pos : tuple, optional
+        Position information (line, column) in the source document where this value
+        was found. Used for generating informative error messages.
+    
+    Returns
+    -------
+    bool
+        True if the string is valid (is None or is a string/Unicode string),
+        False if the string is invalid.
+    
+    Important notes or exceptions
+    -----------------------------
+    - If string is None, it is considered valid and the function returns True
+    - If string is not a string type, a W08 warning is raised according to the
+      verification settings in config
+    - The function uses warn_or_raise internally, so the actual behavior (warning
+      vs exception) depends on the 'verify' setting in the config parameter
+    - This is primarily used for internal VOTable validation and should maintain
+      consistency with VOTable specification requirements for string attributes
+    """
+    if string is None:
+        return True
+    
+    if not isinstance(string, str):
+        warn_or_raise(W08, W08, attr_name, config, pos)
+        return False
+    
+    return True
+
+
+def _get_default_unit_format(config):
+    """
+    Get the default unit format as specified in the VOTable spec.
+    
+    Parameters
+    ----------
+    config : dict
+        Configuration dictionary containing version information and other
+        settings that affect VOTable parsing and writing behavior.
+    
+    Returns
+    -------
+    str
+        The default unit format string. Returns "vounit" for VOTable version
+        1.4 or later, and "cds" for earlier versions.
+    
+    Notes
+    -----
+    The unit format changed between VOTable versions 1.3 and 1.4. This function
+    determines the appropriate default format based on the version information
+    stored in the config dictionary. The version check is performed using the
+    "version_1_4_or_later" key in the config.
+    
+    This addresses issue #10791 regarding the unit format change in VOTable
+    specifications.
+    """
+    if config.get('version_1_4_or_later', False):
+        return 'vounit'
+    return 'cds'

+"""
+VOTable exceptions and warnings module.
+
+This module defines the warning and exception classes used throughout the
+VOTable parsing and generation process, as well as the warn_or_raise utility
+function.
+"""
+
+import warnings
+
+
+class VOTableSpecWarning(UserWarning):
+    """
+    A warning raised when the VOTable specification is violated.
+    """
+    pass
+
+
+class VOTableSpecError(ValueError):
+    """
+    An error raised when the VOTable specification is violated.
+    """
+    pass
+
+
+class VOTableChangeWarning(UserWarning):
+    """
+    A warning raised when a change is made to a VOTable that may affect
+    its validity.
+    """
+    pass
+
+
+class UnimplementedWarning(UserWarning):

+    A warning raised when an unimplemented feature is encountered.
+    """
+    pass
+
+
+class IOWarning(UserWarning):

+    A warning raised for I/O related issues.

+
+

+    The version attribute is required.

+
+

+
+
+class W03(VOTableSpecWarning):

+
+
+class W04(VOTableSpecWarning):

+    W04: Unknown datatype.

+
+
+class W05(VOTableSpecWarning):

+    W05: Invalid arraysize.
+    """
+    message_template = "Invalid arraysize '{}'"
+
+
+class W06(VOTableSpecWarning):
+    """
+    W06: Invalid precision.
+    """
+    message_template = "Invalid precision '{}'"
+
+
+class W07(VOTableSpecWarning):

+    W07: Invalid astroYear.

+

+
+
+class W10(VOTableSpecWarning):

+    W10: Invalid content for element.
+    """
+    message_template = "Invalid content for element '{}'"
+
+
+class W11(VOTableSpecWarning):
+    """
+    W11: No resource element found.
+    """
+    message_template = "No RESOURCE elements found in VOTable file"
+
+
+class W12(VOTableSpecWarning):
+    """
+    W12: Too many resource elements.
+    """
+    message_template = "Too many RESOURCE elements"
+
+
+class W13(VOTableSpecWarning):
+    """
+    W13: Invalid ID.
+    """
+    message_template = "Invalid ID '{}'"
+
+
+class W14(VOTableSpecWarning):
+    """
+    W14: Invalid ucd.
+    """
+    message_template = "Invalid UCD '{}'"
+
+
+class W15(VOTableSpecWarning):
+    """
+    W15: Invalid unit.
+    """
+    message_template = "Invalid unit '{}'"
+
+
+class W16(VOTableSpecWarning):
+    """
+    W16: Invalid ref.
+    """
+    message_template = "Invalid ref '{}'"
+
+
+class W17(VOTableSpecWarning):
+    """
+    W17: Invalid datatype for field.
+    """
+    message_template = "Invalid datatype '{}' for field '{}'"
+
+
+class W18(VOTableSpecWarning):

+    W18: Obsolete element.
+    """
+    message_template = "Obsolete element '{}'"
+
+
+class W19(VOTableSpecWarning):
+    """
+    W19: Attribute not allowed.
+    """
+    message_template = "Attribute '{}' not allowed on element '{}'"
+
+
+class W20(VOTableSpecWarning):
+    """
+    W20: Attribute required.
